sentences.text: Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she is doing a big painting of her cat, Biscuit, and enjoys cooking on Mondays and going to the disco on Fridays.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she lives with her mum at home and helps her with hoovering because her mum's knees are bad.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she sometimes does travel training and wants to get the bus into town on her own.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she currently travels to the centre via a minibus.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she does not like Dave, who drives the minibus.
Leanne Marsh (S2) disclosed that Dave touched her on her chest while she was getting off the minibus outside her house.
Leanne Marsh (S2) disclosed that Dave touched her between her legs over her trousers.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated Dave told her that nobody would believe her.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated Dave kissed her on her mouth.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated Dave told her it was their secret and not to tell her mum.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated Dave touched her every week when she was the last person off the bus.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated the abuse started after the summer, following her birthday in August.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated no staff at Brookside have touched her like that; only Dave has done so.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she is not in trouble and that Dave should not have done what he did.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she would like her mum to be informed about the abuse.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she would prefer to take a taxi to the centre rather than go on Dave's bus, as her mum cannot drive with her knees.
Social worker Angela Okafor (S1) agreed to ring the safeguarding team and the police today.
Social worker Angela Okafor (S1) agreed to talk to Joanne, the centre manager, to arrange a taxi from tomorrow, Wednesday.
Social worker Angela Okafor (S1) agreed to visit Leanne Marsh's house tomorrow at 4 o'clock to tell her mum together.
Social worker Angela Okafor (S1) agreed to ask Sue to set up two practice bus trips into town in December.
Social worker Angela Okafor (S1) agreed to bring Leanne Marsh an easy-read booklet about what happens next.
